question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**closely**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The context of the passage implies that the protagonist carefully examines the inscription on the gravestone.
 
• '**Closely**' (गौर से) fits this context as it means paying careful attention to details.
 
• Observing something '**closely**' highlights the attention to detail necessary for deciphering potentially worn or intricate text on the gravestone.<
